usedFor: Slack holds team chat and Freelo holds project tasks, so “New Message on Slack” can become a task.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message on Slack” in Slack, then “Create Task” in Freelo
bestTemplate.why: The action builds a task with title, due date, assignees and labels from a message.

watchOut: “New Message on Slack” has no channel filter, so every channel and direct message can become a task.
